experiment: OILTRACE isolated model evaluation — HTSM Oil Spill Segmentation
isolation: All work confined to scratch/model_eval/. backend/app/ not modified or imported.

environment.note: Repo pins torch==1.12.1+cu113 / torchvision==0.13.1+cu113 (no Python 3.13 or CPU wheels); used current CPU builds. Repo modules import and build unchanged under torchvision 0.29.

reference_baseline.preprocessing: Reference verbatim (src/app.py): ImagePadder anchor img_0814.jpg -> pad to 672x1280 -> /255 -> -mean(0.5185) -> /std(0.197) -> NCHW -> argmax -> crop [11:661,15:1265].
reference_baseline.timing_method: forward+softmax+argmax on CPU, one warmup pass excluded

spatial_coherence.oil_spill: 309px in 1 connected component, bbox (192,306,32x23) — aligned with the dark feature on the left of the input
spatial_coherence.ship: 45px in 1 compact component, bbox (930,262,8x6) — aligned with the bright point on the right (SAR ship signature)
spatial_coherence.oil_spill_look_alike: 5px in 1 component, bbox (1156,546,3x2) — faint bottom-right mark

reference_baseline.verdict: Plausible 5-class segmentation. 99.96% sea_surface is correct for a genuinely open-ocean scene; minority classes are single coherent components at real image features, not noise.

offline_verification.baseline_inference_offline: PASS — re-ran with HTTP(S)_PROXY forced to a dead address (127.0.0.1:9) + HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 + empty TORCH_HOME; identical output (oil 309, ship 45, sea 99.9558%).
offline_verification.network_dependency: None in the inference path (pretrained=False avoids torchvision hub download; weights/image/stats are local files).

sentinel1_real_scene.reason: No Sentinel-1 GRD .SAFE product was provided (the task's input field was left as the placeholder '<paste your .SAFE product name here>'). Phases 2-4 require a real product and cannot be run without one. Not fabricating a real-scene result.

deviations.author_implementation: ResNet50DeepLabV3Plus(num_classes=5, pretrained=True) -> downloads torchvision ImageNet ResNet-50 weights for the encoder
deviations.reason: Encoder weights are fully overwritten by load_state_dict of the trained checkpoint; pretrained=True only adds a network download.
deviations.expected_impact: None on inference output (weights replaced). Verified numerically identical to expectation; removes a network dependency.

deviations.our_implementation: weights_only=True first, fall back to False
deviations.reason: torch 2.14 changed the default; checkpoint is a pure state_dict.
No Python-3.13 / CPU wheels for the pinned CUDA versions; CPU-only environment.
deviations.expected_impact: Low. Repo modules import and the model builds unchanged; state_dict is version-agnostic. Not asserted bit-identical to the authors' CUDA run.
